title: KANTO >=1000 HIGH-IMPACT UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT
scope: Only the 45 Kanto >=1,000 ledger records classified inventory-unresearched at the start of this wave. Production, formal HOLD/NEED EVIDENCE/DEFER, and duplicate/alias records were excluded.
mode: preflight only: current first-party research and formal triage; no two-pass transcription, source production JSON, ranges, fingerprints, generated catalog/runtime, or production integration.
evidencePolicy: Current first-party issuer material is the decision basis. Secondary material was discovery-only. Capacity is not seat evidence. No capacity fitting, invented seat IDs, geometry completion, or third-party seat-map gap filling is permitted.

method: Prioritized live/concert/theater search demand and metropolitan relevance.
Favored current issuer-owned numbered seating material and purpose-built fixed-seat halls over capacity alone.
Applied a yield penalty to stadiums, exhibition halls, and event-dependent arenas where a complete representative numbered set was less likely.
